findings.description: filter_by_name_match performed a byte-wise/ASCII-only case fold when comparing candidate display names against the @Name token, so a non-ASCII display name (e.g. accented Latin characters) that differed from the token only by case would fail to match even though the names are the same identity under Unicode case-insensitive comparison
